name: top_customer
question: مين أفضل زبون عندي الشهر الماضي من حيث المبيعات؟
ref_sql: SELECT TOP 5 c.Name AS name, SUM({NET}) AS net {JOIN} JOIN t.Customers c ON c.ID = th.CustomerID AND c.CompanyID = th.CompanyID WHERE {W} GROUP BY c.Name ORDER BY net DESC

name: weakest_rep
question: مين أضعف مندوب مبيعات بالشهر الفائت؟
ref_sql: SELECT sp.Name AS name, SUM({NET}) AS net {JOIN} JOIN t.SalesPersons sp ON sp.ID = th.SalesPersonID AND sp.CompanyID = th.CompanyID WHERE {W} GROUP BY sp.Name ORDER BY net ASC

name: top5_customers_en
question: Top 5 customers by sales last month
ref_sql: SELECT TOP 5 c.Name AS name, SUM({NET}) AS net {JOIN} JOIN t.Customers c ON c.ID = th.CustomerID AND c.CompanyID = th.CompanyID WHERE {W} GROUP BY c.Name ORDER BY net DESC

name: invoice_count
question: كم فاتورة بيع طلعنا الشهر اللي فات؟
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS inv FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th WHERE {W}

name: rep_most_invoices
question: اي مندوب عمل اكبر عدد فواتير الشهر الماضي
ref_sql: SELECT TOP 3 sp.Name AS name, COUNT(*) AS inv FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th JOIN t.SalesPersons sp ON sp.ID = th.SalesPersonID AND sp.CompanyID = th.CompanyID WHERE {W} GROUP BY sp.Name ORDER BY inv DESC

name: best_day
question: شو كان أعلى يوم مبيعات بالشهر الماضي وقديش بعنا فيه؟
ref_sql: SELECT TOP 3 th.TransactionDate AS d, SUM({NET}) AS net {JOIN} WHERE {W} GROUP BY th.TransactionDate ORDER BY net DESC

name: buying_customers
question: كم زبون اشترى مني الشهر الماضي؟
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT th.CustomerID) AS custs FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th WHERE {W}

name: worst5_items_en
question: What were my 5 worst selling items last month?
ref_sql: SELECT TOP 5 td.ItemCode AS code, SUM({NET}) AS net {JOIN} WHERE {W} GROUP BY td.ItemCode ORDER BY net ASC
